title: exec-staff-meeting-prep-notes-2026-03-19
content:
Purpose: prep notes for 45-min Exec Staff sync (weekly) — align on top risks, decisions needed, and follow-ups. Keep short; will present as 6 slides + open discussion.

Context: Q2 planning week. Product roadmap prioritization for Hosted API performance projects, Dedicated capacity SLA improvements, ramp plan for Private deployment pilot customers. Hiring velocity still lower than plan; need decision on headcount trade-offs. A recent P0 incident (latency degradation) has led to an SRE action plan — quick status update below.

Proposed agenda (45 min):
1) Quick wins / wins since last week (5 min) — customer wins, launches, infra improvements
2) P0 incident recap + SRE mitigation status (7 min) — ask: sign-off on rollback cadence and communication plan
3) Product priorities & trade-offs for next sprint (10 min) — Hosted throughput vs Dedicated reliability vs Private pilot support; decision: freeze or reallocate 2 engs?
4) Go-to-market updates & key enterprise deals (7 min) — ask: commit to Dedicated trial for two named customers
5) Hiring and budget ask (6 min) — product infra vs SRE headcount trade-off; request: approve 2 IC hires from budget reserve
6) Open risks & escalations (5 min) — regulatory customer asking for on-prem timeline; capacity risk for late-Apr burst

Notes / talking points:
- Wins: Canary rollout of batching improvements reduced median token cost by ~12% in internal test; early telemetry promising but need more samples. Mention in wins.
- P0 incident (2026-03-15): root cause: degraded KV cache eviction under long-tail sequences on a specific kernel. SRE implemented a temporary mitigation: reduce max prefix cache retention and a hotfix kernel flag rolled to 60% of traffic. Metric: p50 latency back to baseline; p95 improved but still ~8% above target on under-provisioned Dedicated nodes. Timeline: plan to full-roll hotfix by 3/21 after regression testing.
- Product trade-offs: two options presented to exec: (A) prioritize Hosted throughput improvements (batching + kernel optimizations) to reduce per-token cost and unite product messaging, (B) prioritize Dedicated reliability (SLA, autoscale) to secure two enterprise deals. Recommend triage: approve temporary reallocation of 1 infra eng to SRE for 6 weeks and keep feature dev on a 2-week freeze for low-impact features.
- GTM: Sales reports two named deals (Acme Health, Nimbus Fintech) requesting Dedicated trial and stricter SLAs; legal needs input on contract template changes. If we can't offer trial timeline <6 weeks, risk losing deal.
- Hiring: recruiting update: offer acceptance rate 55% last quarter vs target 75%. We have budget buffer for 2 hires but need exec sign-off to prioritize SRE/infra.
- Customer ask: on-prem pilot request from GovCorp — needs SOC2+ and isolated deployment, timeline 10-12 weeks; product needs to confirm private control plane tasks and security checklist.

Decision requests for meeting:
- Approve temporary reallocation: 1 infra eng -> SRE for 6 weeks (yes/no)
- Approve committing to Dedicated trials for Acme Health and Nimbus Fintech with proposed timelines (yes/no)
- Approve budgeted hiring of 2 SRE/infra ICs this quarter (yes/no)

Prep for Michael (owner):
- Start the meeting by summarizing wins and high-level decision asks.
- Keep P0 incident recap crisp — metrics + next steps.
- Bring a short slide (1) showing cost vs SLA trade-off (chart) and proposed reallocation impact.
- Be ready to propose fallback: if exec declines reallocation, propose a 4-week sprint to push minimal Dedicated reliability fixes that are low-effort/high-impact.

Open questions to surface:
- Legal: can we sign short-term trial addendum with limited SLA exposure? (ask Legal lead: Emily Nguyen)
- Product: do we have QA capacity to validate hotfix full roll by 3/21? (ask Release Eng: Diego Morales)
- Recruiting: can people ops prioritize SRE candidates given interview slates? (ask People Ops: Ava Thompson)

Meeting outputs to capture: decisions, owners, deadlines, comms plan for customers.
action_items: Michael Chen - Finalize P0 incident brief and slide deck (due 2026-03-19)
Diego Morales - Confirm hotfix regression test plan and sign-off timeline (due 2026-03-20)
Ava Thompson - Flag SRE interview shortlist and expedite offers if approved (due 2026-03-22)
Emily Nguyen - Draft trial contract addendum for Dedicated trials for two customers (due 2026-03-21)
Priya Patel - Prepare cost vs SLA chart and reallocation impact slide (due 2026-03-19)
Sales (Diego / Priya) - Communicate tentative timelines to Acme Health and Nimbus Fintech; set expectations pending exec decision (due 2026-03-20)
Michael Chen - Publish meeting notes and decision summary to Confluence and Slack #exec-summary channel (due 2026-03-19)
